# Sakk

> Sakk stops an AI coding agent before it overspends, leaks a secret or force-pushes. It is a fail-closed pre-tool-use guard for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, a daily spend cap for Claude Code (an estimate from local logs, not the invoice), a kill switch, a secret scanner for git, and a spend ledger for your own agent code. Local, zero dependencies, Node 20+ on macOS or Linux, Apache-2.0.

Install and check it in a project: `npm install -g sakk`, then `sakk guard install claude-code` (or `cursor`, `codex`), then `sakk doctor`. Set a daily cap with `sakk cap set 5 --zone Asia/Dubai`; see today's spend with `sakk spend`. Stop every guarded agent with `sakk halt --by <name>` and lift it with `sakk resume --by <name>`.

Sakk is a report-and-stop tool, not an agent platform: ccusage and Claude Code's `/cost` report spend; Sakk refuses the next call. Names given with `--by` are self-declared, and the cap stops the next call, not the one that crosses it.
